record_type: Authored construction record; not a timestamped execution log, independent review, solver result or gameplay observation
status: Four written composition demonstrations; sixteen prepared generators

constructions.title: Your song becomes the enemy's next rhythm
constructions.seed: User's singing-quality damage idea and existing WM18/WM21 candidates
authored_transformations: Map a chosen three-beat reference phrase to one displayed future enemy combo timing.
Couple faster-tempo burst power to shorter later enemy attack intervals.
Retain one visible pending phrase-derived pattern that cannot be freely overwritten.
constructions.authored_objection: A plain damage multiplier supplies little additional strategy; unreliable sensing or free pattern replacement could erase the declared cost.
constructions.authored_repair: Use a bounded future timing relation, reject uncertain input before expenditure, spend charge on interruption, and disallow overwriting a pending pattern.
constructions.state_change: Phrase completion stores one eligible future combo pattern and produces a capped burst.
constructions.player_cost: Finite charge, cast commitment, and the faster later threat associated with the stronger tempo band
constructions.feedback: Reference phrase, measured conformity, charge expenditure, pending intervals and warned eligible combo
constructions.manual: Perform voice or equivalent timing input, then execute the ensuing dodge/guard sequence.
constructions.autoplay: Author tempo, timing, reserve and escape; do not fabricate human singing errors.
constructions.counter: Disclosed ineligible attack category while retaining useful eligible categories

constructions.title: Every barricade opens another passage
authored_transformations: Literalize the failed promise that more walls always produce safety.
Assign protection and exposure to two linked disclosed passages.
Exchange passage state under finite shared capacity and scheduled expiry.
constructions.authored_objection: Expiry could displace occupants or defeat a committed escape; holding a closing passage might permit free capacity resets.
constructions.authored_repair: Admit only vacant barriers, preserve committed escapes, defer closure while occupied, retain the capacity cost, and forbid free pending-close reactivation.
constructions.state_change: Block A and open B for a provisional twelve-second interval; reopen A at expiry and close B when vacant.
constructions.player_cost: Wall capacity and exposure to the newly opened approach; occupancy keeps capacity committed
constructions.feedback: Socket pairs, pair state, lifetime, pending closure and retained capacity
constructions.manual: Time activation and movement through the changed geometry.
constructions.autoplay: Author pair selection, route and fallback using public state; no hidden route optimization.
constructions.counter: Disclosed enemies exploit the new passage; repair through pair, timing or item choice.
comparisons: Independent wall and gate with matched capacity/time budgets
open_questions: Whether coupling supplies a useful decision

constructions.title: Injuries draw a temporary maze
constructions.seed: Damage reflection and deliberate monster-contact movement
authored_transformations: Retain a location mark from an eligible harmful event without refunding health.
Connect distinct marks into bounded temporary ground-enemy barriers.
Attack the routing assumption with a disclosed flyer and require a mixed response.
constructions.authored_objection: Self-damage farming, unrestricted geometry or an assumption that the existing policy editor supports new marks could conceal important costs.
constructions.authored_repair: Limit eligible hostile direct hits, length, lifetime and capacity; require vacant cells and explicit new policy observations; retain failure if the flyer leaves no useful operation.
constructions.state_change: Consecutive distinct injury marks may form up to two bounded ink segments that block disclosed ground enemies while admitting the hero.
constructions.player_cost: Health loss, exposed hit locations and opportunity to dodge instead
constructions.feedback: Eligible hit, mark positions, segment validity, duration and health reserve
constructions.manual: Choose spacing and the accepted hit, then exploit or clear the resulting geometry.
constructions.autoplay: Needs proposed mark, validity, reserve and deliberate-contact predicates; existing six-rule editor usability is unestablished.
constructions.counter: Disclosed flyer ignores ink; grounded adds may remain routable alongside a timed ranged response.
comparisons: Health-paid placed barrier with equal geometry/lifetime
Existing reflect, maze and poison-path candidates

constructions.title: An item lets you connect a cause to an effect
authored_transformations: Expose a bounded type-compatible source-event/effect choice during a paused item offer.
Move effect activation to the selected guarded-hit or named-route event.
Use one coupling slot, finite nonrenewable charges and shared cooldown so choosing one link costs another.
constructions.authored_objection: Recursive activation or missing targets could permit infinite effects or make the item silently useless; broad effect composition has strong prior art.
constructions.authored_repair: Resolve each source event once, forbid effect-triggered recursion, check targets before expenditure, expose failed checks and allow affordable precommit rebinding or retain a valid target.
constructions.state_change: One bound eligible source event triggers one selected gate-opening or capped magic-burst effect when its target and budget are valid.
constructions.player_cost: One finite coupling slot, provisional three nonrenewable charges per stage and cooldown
constructions.feedback: Source, effect, target binding, eligibility, charges, cooldown and failed target checks
constructions.manual: Choose the link during acquisition, then time the action creating its source event.
constructions.autoplay: Choose the same link and author the source action and reserve condition.
constructions.counter: Warned source pressure or changed target availability, with explicit valid alternatives before commitment

evidence_boundary: The record supports authored candidate production only. No independent role agreement, generator superiority, executable feasibility, player success, balance, enjoyment, learned creativity or global novelty is established.
historical_accounting: Previous six design-role turns, three rounds, twenty-four WM candidates and all earlier experiment counts retain their existing scope. These four MC records are additional authored proposals.
